meta.description: Query the Ensembl REST API for gene/transcript/protein lookup, sequence retrieval, Compara orthologs, VEP variant annotation, regulatory features, archive pinning and Ensembl divisions, through a small Python requests client.

scientific_integrity.detail: No fabricated identifiers or results; every live value (BRCA1 ENSG00000012048 chr17:43044292-43170245, TP53 protein 393 aa, rs699 missense, LD r2 0.976) matched the service.

practice_boundaries.detail: Annotation retrieval only; no diagnostic or prescriptive output.

methodological_ground.detail: Symbol-to-ID resolution and release pinning are sound. A GRCh37 coordinate shown against the GRCh38 default host is a documentation error (ENS-003), not a methodological fallacy.

code_usability.detail: Client functions all ran live; the shipped failures are wrong arguments in two examples and the quickstart snippet (ENS-001, ENS-002), not unrunnable client code. Scored in Layer 1/2 and filed P1.

functional_suitability.note: Client covers lookup, sequence, overlap, VEP, Compara, LD and archive base; the headline gene-ID protein snippet, one example HGVS, the usage-guide VEP coordinate, and two endpoint-table rows (regulatory, homology/id) fail live.

reliability.note: 429 handling exists; no request timeout, no 5xx handling, archive HTML/503 surface as JSONDecodeError or an HTML body, and exhausted 429 retries raise RuntimeError that batch_symbols does not catch.

performance_context.note: SKILL.md is about 170 lines with a usage guide and examples; endpoint table and error table repeat each other.

agent_usability.note: Good symbol-vs-ID, pinning and bulk-defection guidance; the first code block an agent copies crashes with an opaque HTTP 400 and the client discards the server error body.

human_usability.note: Clear tables and failure modes; several stated error behaviours (404 on renamed symbol, Homo_sapiens fails) are not what the service returns.

security.note: No credentials; HTTPS only; path segments are interpolated unescaped into URLs (low risk for an unauthenticated read-only API).

maintainability.note: Single 90-line client with one retry helper and docstrings; examples are not asserted or tested, which is how ENS-001 and ENS-002 shipped.

agent_specific.note: Trigger description is specific; progressive disclosure and escape hatches (BioMart, local VEP) good; examples that fail reduce composability.

inputs.label: Symbol to ID, e110 pinning, gene structure, protein, region overlap (lookup_and_overlap.py)
inputs.note: Steps 1-3 correct; exit 1 at protein step with HTTP 400 on the gene ID; region overlap step never reached.

assertions.text: symbol_to_id('human','BRCA1') returns ENSG00000012048 on GRCh38 at chr17:43044292-43170245, strand -1
assertions.note: Exact match against the live record.

assertions.text: e110 archive returns the same Gene ID with the e110 coordinates
assertions.note: 301 to jul2023 host followed; id ENSG00000012048, start 43044295.

assertions.text: gene_info(expand=1) returns transcripts with exon lists and one canonical transcript
assertions.note: 59 transcripts, canonical ENST00000357654.

assertions.text: The documented quickstart sequence_for_id('ENSG00000139618','protein') returns a protein sequence
assertions.note: HTTP 400: gene plus non-genomic type needs multiple_sequences (15 sequences); same call exits the shipped example.

assertions.text: The shipped example runs to completion and prints the region overlap section
assertions.note: Exit 1 before the overlap section.

inputs.label: VEP by region, dbSNP ID, HGVS with consequence summary (vep_annotation.py)
inputs.note: Region and ID VEP correct; example HGVS ENST00000366667:c.803G>A rejected (reference base at c.803 is C); usage-guide region example on GRCh38 host returns 400.

assertions.text: vep_region 17:43044295-43044295:1 A returns GRCh38 consequences for BRCA1 with allele_string T/A
assertions.note: 3_prime_UTR_variant, 48 transcript consequences.

assertions.text: vep_id rs699 returns a missense AGT consequence with SIFT and PolyPhen
assertions.note: ENST00000366667 M/T, tolerated, benign, position 230710048.

assertions.text: vep_hgvs ENST00000646891:c.1799T>A returns BRAF V600E missense with SIFT and PolyPhen
assertions.note: V/E, probably_damaging.

assertions.text: The shipped HGVS example string is valid for its transcript
assertions.note: Service reports reference C at c.803; c.803C>T works (missense_variant).

assertions.text: The usage-guide chr17:41276135 T>G example returns a result on the default host
assertions.note: That coordinate is GRCh37 BRCA1; default GRCh38 host returns 400, grch37 host returns splice_region_variant.

inputs.label: Compara orthologs and paralogs (compara_homology.py)
inputs.note: Example exits 0; ortholog types and mouse mapping correct; BRCA1 paralog section prints nothing; confidence absent.

assertions.text: TP53 to mouse returns one ortholog_one2one to ENSMUSG00000059552 with identities
assertions.note: perc_id 77.95 target, 77.35 source.

assertions.text: BRCA1 ortholog type counts are internally consistent
assertions.note: 170 one2one + 29 one2many = 199 homologies.

assertions.text: Missing confidence is treated as unknown, per SKILL.md
assertions.note: Value is None for every row and the example prints it without failing.

assertions.text: The example's paralog and confidence text matches service output
assertions.note: Paralog list for BRCA1 is empty and prints a bare header; text describes confidence as binary 0/1 and a many2one type that the service does not emit.

inputs.label: Release pinning: e110, e111, e116, GRCh37, and a retired archive
inputs.note: e110, e111 and GRCh37 reproducible; e116 archive host 503; e90 returns HTML 200 and the client raises JSONDecodeError.

assertions.text: e110 archive resolves BRCA1 with the e110 coordinates
assertions.note: start 43044295 vs live 43044292, same Gene ID.

assertions.text: GRCh37 host returns the legacy assembly coordinates
e111 archive answers /info/data with release 111
assertions.note: {'releases': [111]}.

assertions.text: A very old or unavailable archive fails with a clear, documented error
assertions.note: e116 returns 503 HTML (jun2026 host down, not decommissioned); e90 returns 200 HTML contradicting the doc (DNS failure or 503) and the client raises JSONDecodeError.

inputs.label: Batch symbols with renamed gene, LD, POST batch lookup, divisions, documented endpoint table
inputs.note: Batch, LD, POST lookup and divisions correct; regulatory and homology/id endpoint-table rows 404; stated error codes and species-case rule do not match the service.

assertions.text: batch_symbols captures per-symbol errors and still resolves valid symbols
assertions.note: BRCA1 resolved; MARCH1 and NOTAGENE recorded as errors.

assertions.text: ld_pairwise and POST /lookup/id return expected values
assertions.note: r2 0.976 D' 1.0; POST returned BRCA1 and TP53.

assertions.text: Non-vertebrate lookup by division species name works on the main host
assertions.note: arabidopsis_thaliana NAC001 200; rest.ensemblgenomes.org does not resolve.

assertions.text: Endpoint table rows resolve: /regulatory/species/{species}/feature/{id} and /homology/id/{ensembl_id}
assertions.note: Both 404 (homology needs /homology/id/human/ID).

assertions.text: Documented error behaviour matches service: renamed symbol is 404 and Homo_sapiens fails
assertions.note: Renamed symbol returns 400; Homo_sapiens returns 200.

key_strengths: Compact single client whose functions all returned scientifically correct live values (BRCA1 coordinates, TP53 protein, rs699 and BRAF V600E missense, LD r2 0.976, one2one TP53 orthology).
Release pinning and symbol-to-ID stability guidance is correct and reproducible: e110, e111 and GRCh37 hosts returned the stated gene versions.
Divisions, rate-limit and defection guidance verified live: main host serves plants, rest.ensemblgenomes.org does not resolve, rate headers show 55000 per 3600 s.

recommendations.title: ENS-001 Gene-ID protein quickstart returns HTTP 400
recommendations.problem: sequence_for_id('ENSG00000139618','protein') in SKILL.md and lookup_and_overlap.py fails because a gene ID with a non-genomic type needs multiple_sequences; the example exits before its region step.
recommendations.root_cause: The client has no multiple_sequences parameter and the examples were never executed.
recommendations.fix: Use a transcript or protein ID in the snippet and example (ENSP00000269305), or add a multiple_sequences option and document it.

recommendations.title: ENS-002 VEP HGVS example has wrong reference base
recommendations.problem: ENST00000366667:c.803G>A returns HTTP 400 because the reference base at c.803 is C; the example exits before the bulk-warning text.
recommendations.root_cause: Example HGVS was written without checking the reference allele.
recommendations.fix: Use ENST00000366667:c.803C>T (rs699, missense) or the validated BRAF ENST00000646891:c.1799T>A.

recommendations.title: ENS-003 GRCh37 VEP coordinate sent to GRCh38 host
recommendations.problem: 17:41276135 T>G is BRCA1 in GRCh37; the guide sends it to the default GRCh38 host and gets HTTP 400.
recommendations.root_cause: Coordinate copied from a GRCh37 source while the guide states GRCh38 default.
recommendations.fix: Use a GRCh38 coordinate such as 17:43044295-43044295:1/A, or point the example at the grch37 host.

recommendations.title: ENS-004 Regulatory and homology/id endpoint rows 404
recommendations.problem: /regulatory/species/{species}/feature/{id} returned 404 (also for real ENSR17_ ids, and the variants tried), and /homology/id/{ensembl_id} returns 404 without the species segment.
recommendations.root_cause: Endpoint table was not checked against the live service; the client never exercises these routes.
recommendations.fix: Correct homology to /homology/id/{species}/{id}; replace the regulatory row with the working overlap/region?feature=regulatory route (34 features returned for 17:43.0-43.2 Mb) or verify a current id route.

recommendations.title: ENS-005 Error-code and species-case claims are wrong
recommendations.problem: Renamed or unknown symbols return HTTP 400 (not 404), and Homo_sapiens is accepted (200), contradicting the doc.
recommendations.fix: Say 400 'No valid lookup found' and drop or soften the Homo_sapiens-fails claim.

recommendations.title: ENS-006 Client: no timeout, 5xx or non-JSON handling
recommendations.problem: get_with_retry has no request timeout (a 40 s read timeout occurred on xrefs), does not retry 5xx, returns HTML 503 or e90 HTML 200 pages that raise JSONDecodeError, and exhausted 429 retries raise RuntimeError that batch_symbols does not catch. e116 archive was 503 while the live host was fine.
recommendations.root_cause: Retry helper handles only 429; the archive-failure doc assumes DNS or 503.
recommendations.fix: Add a timeout, retry transient 5xx, check Content-Type before .json(), catch RuntimeError in batch_symbols, and document that a recent archive host can be temporarily down.

recommendations.title: ENS-007 compara example: empty paralogs, stale text
recommendations.problem: The BRCA1 paralog section prints a header with nothing under it, and the closing text calls confidence binary 0/1 and names a many2one type that the service does not return while confidence is absent for every row.
recommendations.root_cause: Example prints static explanatory text rather than data-derived text.
recommendations.fix: Print 'none' for empty results and align the semantics text with SKILL.md (confidence may be absent) and with the types returned.

recommendations.title: ENS-008 No Skill-root LICENSE file
recommendations.problem: Preflight warns that the manifest cites the repository licence only; SKILL.md frontmatter says MIT.
recommendations.root_cause: Origin repository carries the licence at its root.
recommendations.fix: Cite the upstream MIT licence evidence in provenance or add a LICENSE file.
